name: attribute-editor
purpose: An editable list of rows with the same fields, after Cloudscape's attribute editor: key and value pairs (environment variables, headers, metadata) or any set of columns given by a `definition`. It owns the row anatomy every hand-built editor repeats: a label per cell, one control per cell, a per-cell error under the field, Add and Remove, an item limit, the empty text, focus after add and remove, and a polite announcement of each change. A grouped mode lays rows out as AND groups joined by OR, the shape of rule criteria. With `reorderable`, rows (and groups) carry a grip and Move up / Move down buttons, so the order itself is part of the value, as in rule criteria evaluated top to bottom. It edits an array and validates nothing itself: the consumer passes `errors`.
useWhen: Use AttributeEditor for a short list of same-field rows the person adds and removes inside a form (environment variables, headers). For key/value tags on a resource use TagEditor; to edit many cells of many records in place, spreadsheet-style, use DataGrid; for read-and-act lists use Table.
Users add, edit and remove a variable number of pairs or tuples: environment variables, request headers, query arguments, labels, metadata.
Rule criteria: conditions inside a group must all match (and), groups are alternatives (or).
A bulk form where each row has the same two to four fields and a row-level error can occur.
An ordered list of rows where the order matters (criteria evaluated top to bottom, header precedence): turn on `reorderable`.
avoidWhen: Key and value tags with limits, reserved prefixes and removal of saved tags → use `tag-editor`, which is built on this component.
A fixed set of named settings on one resource → use `field` controls in a form.
Many records the user browses, filters and acts on → use `data-table` with row actions.
Many cells of many records edited in place, spreadsheet-style → use `data-grid`.
An ordered list of actions whose argument fields change per type → compose it by hand as in the behaviors of the `edit/rule-builder` block.
related: `tag-editor` — key and value tags with limits and validation, on top of AttributeEditor.
`field` — every cell is a `Field` with its label, control and error.
`input` — the default control of a cell; any control can replace it through `cell-<key>`.
`separator` — the "or" between groups in grouped mode.
`edit/rule-builder` (block) — its criteria are this component in grouped mode (AND rows inside a group, OR between groups), with a `Combobox` variable cell.
bestPractices: Keep two to four columns; more columns belong in a drawer per row.
Pass `errors` only after the first Save (rule of the form-validation block), then keep them live while the user fixes the rows.
Use `minItems: 1` when the form needs at least one row, so the last row keeps its fields and loses its Remove.
Set `limit` when the backend has one; the component says how many rows are left and disables Add at the limit.
Replace a cell's control through `cell-<key>` (a `Select` for an operator, a `Switch` for secret) instead of drawing rows by hand; use `row` only when the row needs a layout of its own.

Type the rows with your own interface (`ref<Header[]>`): `value` in `cell-<key>` and `item` in every slot then carry the field types, so a `Select` or `Switch` binds `value` without `as string` / `as boolean`.
Name the editor (`ariaLabel`) after what the rows are: "Environment variables", "Request headers".
Turn on `reorderable` only when the order changes behavior; an unordered list (environment variables) stays without grips.

props.name: definition
props.doc: Columns of every row: key of the item field, label, placeholder, required.

props.name: errors
props.doc: Error per cell, aligned with the rows (nested per group in grouped mode). Empty shows none.

props.name: addButtonLabel
props.doc: Label of the Add button. Empty uses the locale catalog.

props.name: removeButtonLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the Remove button, followed by the row number. Empty uses the locale catalog.

props.name: addGroupLabel
props.doc: Label of the Add group button in grouped mode. Empty uses the locale catalog.

props.name: emptyTitle
props.doc: Text shown when there are no rows. Empty uses the locale catalog.

props.name: limit
props.doc: Most rows allowed (per group in grouped mode); Add is disabled at the limit and the rows left are announced.

props.name: groupLimit
props.doc: Most groups allowed in grouped mode.

props.name: minItems
props.doc: Fewest rows kept; rows at the minimum lose their Remove button.

props.name: newItem
props.doc: Builds a new row. Unset creates an item with an empty string per column key.

props.name: itemRemovable
props.doc: Hides Remove on the rows it returns false for. Unset makes every row removable.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size of the default controls and the Remove button, on the 28 / 32 / 40 rhythm.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables every control, Add and Remove.

props.name: addDisabled
props.doc: Disables Add only, for example until the last row is filled in.

props.name: reorderable
props.doc: Shows a grip and Move up / Move down on every row (and every group in grouped mode) when there is more than one; rows move by dragging the grip, with the buttons, with Arrow Up / Arrow Down on the grip or Alt+Arrow Up / Alt+Arrow Down anywhere in the row. The new order goes out through v-model.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the list of rows.

events.name: add
events.payload: (event: MouseEvent, detail: { index: number; groupIndex?: number })
events.notes: After a row is added; `groupIndex` only in grouped mode.

events.name: remove
events.payload: (event: MouseEvent | KeyboardEvent, detail: { index: number; item: TItem; groupIndex?: number })

slots.name: row
slots.scope: { item, index, groupIndex, errors, update, remove, removable, removeLabel, move }
slots.notes: Replaces the whole row; the column header and the reorder controls are not drawn. `remove` takes the activating event (`@click="remove"`); `move(event, offset)` moves the row when `reorderable` is on.

slots.name: row-actions
slots.scope: { item, index, groupIndex, remove, removable, removeLabel }
slots.notes: Replaces the Remove button at the end of a default row (for example Remove / Undo that marks a row instead of deleting it). `remove` takes the activating event.

slots.name: actions
slots.notes: Extra buttons after Add (for example Upload or Paste .env).

slots.name: info
slots.notes: Extra help text under the buttons, after the limit text.

slots.name: limit
slots.notes: Replaces the limit text in list mode (for example "You can add 3 more tags.").
